prior_credit.prior_review: D. Bourdeau; source-image and arithmetic review by icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro (2026-11-02)
prior_credit.contribution: Exact conditional completion, source-coordinate pricing and independent native word checks. The ship-routing interpretation and proposed phrase were already present; no priority claim is made for them.

limits: All 290 source slots, the native frame and the published Nov1-3 key remain unchanged.
The source fixes 142 of 145 plaintext positions. The proposed 145-position layer requires three source-mask fills and no observed-coordinate substitutions.
Source70 remains a disputed D/E-like glyph in the conservative transcription. Filling it with D is conditional and is not a new visual reading.
The three unknown half-coordinate pairs allow 216 complete cryptographic witnesses. The selected W,C,F labels are a lexical reading, not a unique consequence of the cipher.

Native WELCHES in p86 A supports the WELCHE stem, and native SCHIFFE occurs in p98 A2; the p86 inflection is different from the target phrase. The p98 witness uses the same key and concerns ships from Kospoli to Odessa/Nikolayev; it is not an identical retransmission.
Literal EZ, V O FECH, names, numbers and all other plaintext labels are retained. No office-title expansion or new historical identification is asserted.
One existing physical record is completed conditionally; no new source record is counted.
